featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Madhav,

Thank you for taking the time to share such detailed feedback with us. We’re truly sorry to hear that your experience at Frozen Fun did not meet your expectations — we completely understand how frustrating that can feel.

We’d first like to clarify that, in addition to our digital menu displays, we do maintain detailed menus on our gelato display counters as well as on each table for convenience. That said, we’re really sorry if this wasn’t clearly visible during your visit — your feedback helps us improve how we present this better.

Regarding pricing at the display counter, we intentionally do not place price tags directly next to each flavour. This is to maintain a clean, hygienic, and premium presentation, allowing the focus to stay on the artisanal gelato itself. However, our team is always available to guide you through sizes, flavours, and pricing — and we’re sorry if that support wasn’t provided clearly during your visit.

Just to clarify on pricing — our small cup starts at ₹220, and the final price depends on:

-> the size you choose,

-> the category of flavour (Premium or Deluxe), and

-> whether you choose to add toppings, which are optional and charged separately.

We understand that gelato can sometimes look similar to ice cream, so it’s important to explain the difference.

Ice cream typically has about 50% air and hence looks more voluminous compared to gelato which only incorporates about 10 to 15%. So while a traditional ice cream scoop weight about 60 to 65 grams, our smallest cup of gelato weighs 90 to 100gms. Gelato is denser and packed with more product and less air. Here’s a quick breakdown of our portions:

65 ml cup → 90–100 g

110 ml cup → 150–160 g

250 ml cup → 250–270 g

Volumes can sometimes look visually different depending on whether the flavors include heavy toppings or not, but every portion is carefully packed to be fair and generous and to maintain the grammage.

We also noticed your comparison with another brand, and we completely respect that perspective. At Frozen Fun, every batch of gelato is handcrafted in small quantities under the guidance of experienced Italian chefs, using premium ingredients sourced from around the world. This commitment to authenticity, freshness, and quality is what shapes our pricing. Our aim is not just to sell dessert, but to offer a truly premium, authentic gelato experience.

We understand that value means different things to different people, and your feedback helps us reflect and improve how we communicate this better. Even if our gelato felt different from what you’ve tried elsewhere, we truly hope you could taste the care and craftsmanship behind it.

Thank you once again for sharing your thoughts. If you’d ever like to talk more or give us another chance, feel free to reach out to us at info@frozenfun.com or call/WhatsApp us at 9311870046. We’d love the opportunity to serve you again and make your experience even better

featured_reviews.name: Shamit Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pros
1. Low Sugar content
2. Strawberry and Classic are fantastic base options
3. Wide variety of toppings
4. Deceptively filling (A large could take 30 minutes to finish casually)
5. 6th day of every month carries a one on one free offer that's a no brainer grab
Cons
1. Base options are limited otherwise. No pineapple, coffee, chocolate, saffron, pistachio, Greek etc.
2. Servings cannot be customised. Most yogurt joints have a self-serve option that charges you only based on the weight, irrespective of the toppings or mixture of yogurt types.
3. Toppings are variegated but sorted differently with respect to the price. Basic toppings like chocolate fudge sauce, Nutella, compotes are placed in the premium category.

Yogurt has become a jargon for the person who really is seeking a tasty and healthy option. Its insanely difficult to find a good yogurt joint because they sprout with marketing gimmicks and delectable flavours that are artificially concocted calorie bombs.
I hadn't outright decided to try 6th street yogurt. My friend persuaded me to join him on the 6th because he had heard about it from a mutual friend. It's easy to spot from the main road as it is just round the corner of a lane at the foot of Kemps Corner.
There are 4 offerings of Yogurt flavours. Classic with a tinge of vanilla, Strawberry, Cranberry Melon and Blueberry. On inquiring with the employee I was told that all the flavours were 100% natural. They let you taste each to make a more decisive pick. I stuck my guns with the original and mounted it with dark chocolate and walnut fudge sauce for a healthy calorie intake. To my surprise, it was actually under-sweet.
Toppings are gamut. You got Oreo, chocolate chips and other chocolate based sauces, Compotes, fresh cut fruits, dried fruits and for the more colourful- red velvet, sprinkles, M&M and many more.
The joint is small, so it's best to take the cup and amble on the pavement while taking small bites or visiting at an uncommon hour if you're interested to stay put and eat.
Coming to the big question - can this yogurt topple your other dessert options?
Well, on some days, definitely. On a normal day, you would be spending roughly 200 on the yogurt (I recommend taking at least a size up from the smallest with one or two toppings.) It can replace your midday meal with a hearty and cold delight.

featured_reviews.review_text:
A perennial favorite among locals and tourists alike, Haji Ali Juice Centre is an iconic culinary landmark nestled at the threshold of the historic Haji Ali Dargah. Since its inception in the 1960s, this bustling establishment has cultivated a legendary status, evolving from a modest stop for pilgrims into a vibrant gastronomic institution. It is celebrated for its unwavering commitment to quality, utilizing fresh, seasonal ingredients to craft an extensive repertoire of refreshments that have become synonymous with Mumbai's street food culture.
Reviewers frequently highlight the establishment's ability to maintain high standards of hygiene and flavor despite the immense daily crowds. The atmosphere is quintessentially Mumbai—a high-energy, casual setting where patrons often enjoy their treats standing on the pavement or from the comfort of their cars, adding a unique drive-in charm to the experience.
• Signature Fruit Creams: The "Sitaphal" (custard apple) cream is universally acclaimed as a must-try masterpiece, featuring a luscious, thick consistency generously laden with fresh fruit chunks.
• Exotic Shakes & Juices: Guests often praise the Mango Milkshake for its rich, creamy texture and the "Triveni"—a sophisticated blend of mango, strawberry, and kiwi juices.
• Savoury Accompaniments: Beyond beverages, the menu boasts popular fusion snacks like the Jain Pizza and the indulgent Cheese Toast, noted for its generous cheese-to-bread ratio.
• Late-Night Accessibility: Operating from the early morning until well past midnight, it serves as a reliable sanctuary for night revelers seeking high-quality refreshments.
